Trust should have something behind it.

A little less hype.
A lot more straight answers.

We would rather explain what is true than fill this page with stars we have not earned.

Honest product information.

Ingredients, allergens and nutrition must match the final product. A nice label is not a substitute for verification.

Clear AI disclosure.

Jeff and Steff are AI coaches. They are not presented as real staff or qualified clinicians.

Your choices stay yours.

Quantities, preferences and overrides should be respected. No silent “optimisation”.

No invented reviews.

This preview does not use fabricated testimonials, customer counts or trust ratings.

Visible subscription terms.

Show the contents, renewal interval and charge before commitment. No pre-ticked subscription consent.

Own the mistakes.

Clear explanations and practical help. Humour is not an excuse to dodge a serious problem.

A reasonable thing to do before parting with your money.
